description: Gets you an alert by webhook when new events of the kinds you choose land, filtered on the event and on the ticker's signals. Webhooks need a paid plan (Free has no webhook slots). One `q` covers the event's fields (with one kind, bare: `firm = 'Goldman Sachs'`) and the ticker's signals at fire time (`market_cap > 1e10`); on a name clash (`price`, `cik`) the ticker signal wins; the event's own value is `payload->>'price'`. Latency is the ingest cadence (analyst ≤1h, corporate kinds daily), not sub-minute.

channel.description: Delivery channel: `webhook` (POST to `target_url`), `discord` (an embed at `discord_url`), `in_app` (the dashboard only) or `mobile_push` (to `device_id`). Inferred when omitted: `discord` if `discord_url` is set, else `mobile_push` if `device_id` is set, else `webhook` if `target_url` is set, else `in_app`. See Delivery channels.

device_id.description: Only with `channel=mobile_push`. Device to notify, from `POST /v2/devices/register`. An unknown id is a 400 `device_not_found`.

discord_url.description: Only with `channel=discord`. Discord incoming-webhook URL (`https://discord.com/api/webhooks/…`). Stored as a posting credential: the create response echoes it back under `channel_config`, but every later read (list, get, deliveries) strips it and sets `channel_config_present: true` instead.

kind.description: Event kinds to fire on, an array or a comma list. `filing` fires when a 10-K, 20-F, 40-F or 10-Q lands (the next morning's EDGAR index read); `estimate_revision` when the nightly consensus refresh moves an EPS estimate, one event per fiscal period and horizon that moved (about 1,000 a night across the market). Values: dividend, split, insider, analyst, earnings, filing, estimate_revision.

name.description: Display name, up to 80 characters. Defaults to `events: <kinds> · <scope>`.

q.description: The filter, as on Query events with `join=state`: the event's own fields (`id`, `ticker`, `ts`, `kind`, `payload`, and with one kind its payload fields by bare name) and the ticker's signals at fire time, in one WHERE clause. A payload field and a signal with the same name resolve to the signal, as on Query events: `price` on insider, `cik` on filing. Spell the event's own value `payload->>'price'`. Custom signals are expanded and frozen at creation.

select.description: What each delivered event carries: `id`, `ticker`, `ts` and `kind` always, then the names you list, at the top level: `payload`, the payload fields of the one kind named, and ticker signals at fire time. Omitted: each event as on Query events (`payload` whole).

target_url.description: Only with `channel=webhook`. HTTPS URL each delivery is POSTed to.

ticker.description: One ticker or a comma list (up to 50). Not combinable with `universe`. Omit both for every ticker.

universe.description: Scope to a built-in universe (`top_10`, `top_100`) or one of your own, by id. An unknown one is a 400 `universe_not_found` naming it.

name: tickerbot_subscribe_events
